exposure: correct timing of pre-operative antibiotic prophylaxis
procedure type (cardiac surgery, laminectomy, hip or knee arthroplasty)
outcome: monomicrobial S. aureus surgical site infection (SSI)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 229,765 surgical patients from the Swiss multi-centre SSI surveillance system.
finding: The study found a significant decrease in the rate of meticillin-susceptible S. aureus (MSSA) surgical site infections (SSI) over a six-year period in Switzerland, while identifying various independent protective and risk factors for S. aureus SSI.
